name: Voxel Culling and Ambient Occlusion
definition: A technique to render only visible voxel faces by culling internal voxels and applying ambient occlusion based on the presence of neighbouring voxels. It uses a Moore neighbourhood to determine visibility and a Von Neumann neighbourhood mask for occlusion calculations.
summary: Voxel Culling and Ambient Occlusion renders sparse voxel grids by culling internal voxels and applying occlusion via Moore and Von Neumann neighbourhood masks for efficient real-time performance.
